answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks via microclimatic entropy attestation. Nodes authenticate by streaming barometric telemetry from physical probes situated in a garden, an orchard, or a tundra. Verifying these micro-fluctuations against regional weather forces attackers to incur the verifiable capital cost of deploying discrete hardware across geographic sites. However, severe localized storms can decorrelate sensor readings, causing honest agents to be falsely rejected.
